hooks.prompt:
The OBC (Obsidian Commands) skill is available with 30 vault commands. Based on time of day and session context, consider suggesting a relevant command:

- Morning (before noon): /context to load vault state, then /today for daily planning
- Evening (after 5pm): /close-day to process the day's notes
- Monday morning: /7plan for weekly planning, /drift to check alignment
- When starting deep work: /context first, then the relevant command

Do NOT automatically run any command. Only mention the suggestion briefly if the user hasn't specified a task.
